mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation r JOIN reservation_line l ON r.enterprise_id=l.enterprise_id AND r.warehouse_id=l.warehouse_id AND r.id=l.reservation_id JOIN stock_balance b ON l.enterprise_id=b.enterprise_id AND l.warehouse_id=b.warehouse_id AND l.balance_id=b.id WHERE r.enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND r.warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND b.lot_id=#{lotId} AND r.state IN ('TRIED','CONFIRMED') AND l.remaining_qty>0
